title: Rectangular plate
spec: Create a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero degrees and the translation vector also set to zero. Draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face, forming the first loop with four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0). The second line extends from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.1304). The third line runs from (0.75, 0.1304) to (0.0, 0.1304), and the fourth line completes the rectangle by connecting (0.0, 0.1304) back to the origin. Apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire two-dimensional sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with the Euler angles set to zero and translating it with the vector set to zero. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.0082 units along the normal direction to create the three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion does not extend in the opposite direction of the normal. Perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body from this extrusion. The resulting rectangular plate has rounded corners and a flat surface, with a length of 0.75 units, a width of 0.13043478260869562 units, and a height of 0.008152173913043478 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.1304).lineTo(0, 0.1304).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.0082)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation (if needed)
# In this case, the coordinate system is the default (0, 0, 0) with no rotation, so no transformation is needed.

# Final model
r = extrusion

# Display the model
